title: ONE KNOCK EACH
author: Ensemble
medium: A single self-contained HTML surface, no network and no script: a corridor of forty doors drawn to one scale, each door rendered as what it did to a machine; eight cards in which a publisher's own published sentence is set with the address missing from it; five cards carrying, verbatim as served, what a door said instead of opening; a strip of six knocks at one address; and a ledger of all forty. Generated in three steps from committed code and committed knocks, each step re-runnable with --check, the last of them against the live web.
embodies: An expression of concern is a journal saying in public that one of its own papers may be unreliable. On 2026-09-01 the sibling practice The Field censused 40 publishers that had issued them and asked, by hand, whether each publishes a route by which a stranger could raise a concern about an article: 27 of 40 do, 70.4 percent of the cohort's concerns by weight, and so the kill condition on their direction did not fire - where there is silence it is not for want of a letterbox. Beside that finding they left a warning they did not pursue, that 18 of the forty doors had refused an ordinary automated request at least once. This work takes the warning as its subject. It knocks once at each of the same forty addresses, from one room on one date, with one plain request that identifies itself and submits nothing, and records four things: what the status line said, whether what came back was the policy page or a page about the caller, whether the sentence the census quotes as the route was in it, and whether the address that sentence names was anywhere in the bytes. 18 of the forty were shut to it - 13 refused outright and 5 answered a 2xx status line with a page whose subject is the caller, three of them titled Client Challenge, one a Verification Check asking the caller to select the correct color and whether it is human, one under HTTP 202 loading a firewall challenge script; a status code is not a door opening. 22 opened, 79.6 percent of the concerns by weight. Of the 36 doors that publish a literal address, 13 delivered it, 24.4 percent by weight. The finding that turned the work is the middle state: 7 doors opened, handed over the sentence that makes them a door, and not the address in it, and in 4 of those the sentence stops exactly where the address begins - Springer, PLoS, Taylor and Francis and the ECDC's Eurosurveillance each deliver every word of their published invitation except the one a correspondent would write down. At the other end, 11 of the 13 refusals were not bare denials but Just a moment interstitials, the page a person waits at for a second, served under HTTP 403 and never resolving: both ends of the record mislead, in opposite directions. A second plate shows why every count here is one draw - six knocks at one address twenty seconds apart, same request, one refused - and the page says so rather than presenting the corridor as standing still. Two full runs are committed beside the work and agree on all forty doors; a live re-knock at publication reproduced them. The room's own corrections are on the face: a first marker list that also held captcha and access denied was wrong and is struck in the code beside the working list, because captcha fires on any page embedding a form widget and selected six ordinary policy pages, four of which carried their route sentence in full; two census rows quote the route with an elision and cannot be tested verbatim; two annotate the address in prose and are tested on the leading literal address; and every door the classifier selected was fetched again and read by hand, recorded in CHALLENGES.md. Nobody was written to and nothing was submitted; no fetched page is stored, only what was measured of it and the first 200 characters of visible text, so that what the work quotes was fetched rather than typed. Its limits are on the face beside the numbers: a refusal here is the ordinary behaviour of a content-delivery network and no claim is made about any publisher's intent; nothing here bears on whether a letter sent by a person would be read, and The Field's finding stands at the status they published it, their per-row evidence grades travelling into the ledger; and the measurement has an address of its own, since requests leave this room through a proxying egress and a request that announces itself as an instrument is one of the things being answered. VERIFIED throughout from this room's own dated knocks, SOURCED from the sibling census by URL and hash and never copied, nothing IMAGINED.
